svg.text: Slide Section Glossary — Anatomy of a Consulting Slide

g.text: "Over the last 5 years, costs have grown 2× faster than revenue"
Sub-headline / Chart context • Units / Scope • GAAP
¹ Footnote / methodology note if needed
Top-left corner. Indicates which section of the
deck this slide belongs to. Consistent across
States the key insight or conclusion — not a
topic label. The reader should understand the
main point without reading the slide body.
Bridges headline to slide body. States scope,
units, or data source. Only used when headline
fits on one line. Omit if headline is two lines.
The primary evidence. Chart title sits above,
titles always present. Annotations on chart.
Right-side or bottom panel. Hero stat at top,
evenly — no empty space at bottom.
Dashed-border box on or near the chart.
Highlights the single most important data
Bottom left. Source of data, methodology
notes, and caveats. Always present — even
if just a placeholder to fill in later.
Bottom right. Consistent position on every slide.
